correctness.rationale: The 12 facets of one facet-stacking define the precise 5-sphere. Independent enumeration yields double face vector (27,165,180) and rank d2=134 over p=2,3,5,101, giving beta1=5,beta2=46 once connected. Independently reconstructed 139 edge-path generators/180 triangle words, performed 134 valid single-occurrence Tietze eliminations and obtained exactly five generators [48,88,91,95,98] with 46 remaining relators, 20 nonempty. Direct inspected surviving relators force all six commutators among the last four and the four commutators with generator 48; every retained word has zero exponent sums, so pi1=Z^5 and cellular differential2=0 on remaining 2-complex.
